VideoGameSeries.author: Dan Brickley
VideoGameSeries.message:
Generalized Series, added VideoGameSeries.
Made some adjustments to VideoGame-related types to
reference VideoGameSeries, and small tweaks to descriptions.
https://github.com/rvguha/schemaorg/issues/148

MovieSeries.author: Dan Brickley
MovieSeries.message:
Fine-grained tweaking of Series-related type/properties links.
Emphasis on domainIncludes rather than rangeIncludes, we
push media-related properties down onto TVSeries, RadioSeries,
VideoGameSeries and MovieSeries. For example, all of these
might have actor, whereas a MovieSeries doesn't usually have
episodes. Also further legacy cleanup removing redundant types.

The Series type has a new more general description.

We move Periodical under Series, and add MovieSeries and BookSeries
as placeholders.

Issue tracking:

https://github.com/rvguha/schemaorg/issues/148
https://github.com/rvguha/schemaorg/issues/169

http://www.w3.org/community/schemabibex/wiki/Periodicals_and_Comics_synthesis

"publisherImprint" instead of "imprint", and "comicArtist" instead of "artist".

FrontWheelDriveConfiguration.author: Dan Brickley
FrontWheelDriveConfiguration.message:
Updated with some missing automotive vocabulary that was supposed to be included in Core.

Summary:

properties:

bodyType
vehicleIdentificationNumber (vin)
cargoVolume
vehicleConfiguration (was configuration)
knownVehicleDamages (was damages)
dateVehicleFirstRegistered (was dateFirstRegistered ) DISCUSS
doors (added as numberOfDoors)
driveWheelConfiguration
fuelType
vehicleInteriorColor (was interiorColor)
vehicleInteriorType (was interiorType)
mileageFromOdometer
vehicleModelDate (was modelDate)
numberOfPreviousOwners (was previousOwners)
productionDate ( generalized: "e.g." vehicle, added broader domain Product)
purchaseDate (generalized similarly)
vehicleSeatingCapacity (seatingCapacity)
vehicleTransmission (originally transmission)
steeringPosition
vehicleSpecialUsage (was specialUsage )

type:
CarUsageType

enums:
RentalVehicleUsage, RentalVehicleUsage, DrivingSchoolVehicleUsage, TaxiVehicleUsage

See also #262

Note that some of these renamings or definition tweaks were not fully discussed with
Martin Hepp, although from our prior discussions I believe they ought to be uncontroversial.

The reason for the tweaks is that we are trying to avoid using generic term names for
specific meanings. Therefore we either add more context into the term name, or soften the
definition to be applicable in more situations. In this case we have mostly made the terms
more specific.

/cc @tmarshbing @vholland

identifier.author: Dan Brickley
identifier.message:
First cut at a superproperty for our (mainly textual) identifiers.
See #1286

In collaboration with @andrea-perego at W3C TPAC event.

While the core usecase is textual IDs, the property name is
'identifier' rather than e.g. 'textId' to allow it to be used with URL
values more easily.

The property is useful:

1. For scientific scenarios eg. Dataset description
2. For providing a view of schema.org's large collection of identifying properties.
3. To provide an option when schema.org does not have a dedicated property.

FundingScheme.author: Dan Brickley
FundingScheme.message:
Worked on definitions with @dcodings -
We removed (commented out) the 3 attempts to represent reification
(tried Role pattern; Action pattern and a dedicated type).
This means that we don't yet have a graph shape that captures
the link between a project/grant/person as an extensibly-describable
thing. We will come back to this as it relates to different
reification options in Wikidata (which has edge labels), RDF, etc.
(see also PropertyGraph datamodel discussions).

We are adding types for Project (conceptualized as an Organization)
and FundingAgency, FundingScheme (both as project subtypes), ...

For discussion.

NegativeFilmDigitalSource.author: Dan Brickley
NegativeFilmDigitalSource.message:
Updated following call with Brendan Quinn (@bquinn) from IPTC.

1. Included skos:exactMatch from each term to the http-based URIs IPTC
   assign as their official IDs.
2. Linked the human-facing text to the https-based page for each, and to
   the page for the general scheme.
3. Confirmed our approach regarding "mutually exclusive" makes broad
   sense.
4. Brendan noted that it is important to be clear that these are *types*
   of source not the specific actual sources of specific actual images.
  In Schema.org this is carried by the /digitalSourceType property
having "type" in its name. We decided not to push this into the
enumeration term IDs too for fear of syllable overload (e.g. "foo.jpeg
has a digital source type of Composite With Trained Algorithm Media Digital
Source" is wordy enough already, without "Type" appended).
5. Not explicitly discussed but noting here: this mapping into
   Schema.org doesn't include the older "retired concept" from IPTC,
"created by software", as their "use more specific terms" recommendation is correct.

TrainedAlgorithmicMediaDigitalSource.author: Dan Brickley
TrainedAlgorithmicMediaDigitalSource.message:
Updated following call with Brendan Quinn (@bquinn) from IPTC.

1. Included skos:exactMatch from each term to the http-based URIs IPTC
   assign as their official IDs.
2. Linked the human-facing text to the https-based page for each, and to
   the page for the general scheme.
3. Confirmed our approach regarding "mutually exclusive" makes broad
   sense.
4. Brendan noted that it is important to be clear that these are *types*
   of source not the specific actual sources of specific actual images.
  In Schema.org this is carried by the /digitalSourceType property
having "type" in its name. We decided not to push this into the
enumeration term IDs too for fear of syllable overload (e.g. "foo.jpeg
has a digital source type of Composite With Trained Algorithm Media Digital
Source" is wordy enough already, without "Type" appended).
5. Not explicitly discussed but noting here: this mapping into
   Schema.org doesn't include the older "retired concept" from IPTC,
"created by software", as their "use more specific terms" recommendation is correct.

ITPhilanthropicEntityCharity.author: Manuel Dalla Lana
ITPhilanthropicEntityCharity.message:
Correct and expand Italian nonprofit type definitions (#4862)

Fix outdated or inaccurate legal references in the ITNonprofitType
enumeration (issue #3629): anchor ODV and APS to the Third Sector Code
(Legislative Decree 117/2017, Arts. 32 ff. and 35 ff.), coordinate
mutual aid societies (Law 3818/1886) with Arts. 42 ff. of the Code,
describe imprese sociali under Legislative Decree 112/2017 as amended,
tie social cooperatives to Law 381/1991 with the ex lege social
enterprise status under Art. 1(4) of Legislative Decree 112/2017, and
update amateur sports entities (SSD) to Legislative Decrees 36/2021 and
39/2021. Add the missing Third Sector categories: philanthropic
entities (Arts. 37 ff.), associative networks (Art. 41) and a residual
value for other RUNTS-registered Third Sector entities.
